_comment: Hand-maintained corrections applied on top of the scraped fusion-properties.json.
Use this when the game disagrees with the wiki, or the wiki lags behind a game update.
Each entry is a partial patch keyed by shard id. Keys starting with '_' are ignored,
so '_name' is free to use as a human-readable label.
'fuse_amount' may also be overridden directly even though it isn't a scraped field.
Set '_exclude': true to drop a shard entirely (e.g. it's on the wiki/alpha but hasn't
shipped on this branch yet). An _exclude patch shouldn't also carry field edits --
the shard is removed after overrides are applied, so edits would be discarded anyway.
While any override is present, including an _exclude, the wiki drift assertions in
build-properties.py report as warnings instead of failing the build.
This file is expected to differ between branches: keep a shard excluded here until
it ships on that branch's release, then delete its entry so the next scrape picks it up.
